title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.06598v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy

translated_title: SimForcing：将仿真运动先验蒸馏到真实域机器人世界模型中
translated_abstract: 动作条件化的机器人世界模型必须对机器人轨迹做出精确响应，同时保持逼真的视觉动态，然而从异构的机器人视频中同时学习这两者仍然具有挑战性。仿真可以提供结构化的运动监督，但外观差异阻碍了直接迁移，且不准确的仿真预测可能会误导真实视频的生成。我们提出了SimForcing，这是一个仿真引导的框架，它将仿真既作为可迁移运动知识的来源，又作为预测的可控参考。首先，我们通过潜空间运动蒸馏从仿真教师模型中迁移运动知识，在潜空间中对齐时间变化以内化运动先验，同时减轻外观差异的影响。其次，我们引入了带条件丢弃的多块仿真条件化机制，以利用预测的仿真轨迹，而不会过度依赖其准确性。
tldr: SimForcing通过潜空间运动蒸馏和多块仿真条件化（带条件丢弃）机制，将仿真中的运动先验迁移到真实域机器人世界模型中，同时规避了外观差异和仿真预测不准确带来的负面影响。
en_tdlr: SimForcing distills simulation motion priors into real-domain robot world models through latent-motion distillation and multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout, overcoming appearance discrepancies and unreliable simulation predictions.
